rules: Make-up restores an uncompleted required opportunity; it is not automatically punishment.
Remediation addresses insufficient academic/practical performance and is not automatically misconduct.
Excused absence may still require make-up if the learning/duty requirement remains unmet.
Successful remediation does not erase the historical event that caused it.
Remediation completion and academic score effects are resolved by the appropriate evaluation system.
Repeated failure after remediation may become progression evidence but Step 18 owns annual outcome.
